sloka: चिक्रीडुः सह भार्याभिरप्सरोभिरिवामराः ।ततो माल्यवतो भार्या सुन्दरी नाम सुन्दरी ।। ७.५.३५ ॥
transliteration: cikrīḍuḥ saha bhāryābhirapsarobhirivāmarāḥ ।tato mālyavato bhāryā sundarī nāma sundarī ।। 7.5.35 ॥

translations.english: They sported with their wives like gods with Apsaras; then, Malyavan's wife, named Sundari, who was beautiful...
